chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Ignore the pain and sorrow, and you will be content forever.
ai.seo_question: How can one achieve lasting happiness by managing pain and sorrow according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) links the spiritual practice of overlooking minor afflictions (al-qadha) with enduring inner peace (al-alam). This teaching reflects the Shia emphasis on sabr (patience) and hilm (forbearance) as active virtues that transform transient suffering into lasting spiritual contentment. It underscores the principle that true happiness arises not from the absence of pain, but from the conscious choice to disregard trivial grievances.
